name: guitar-beginner-foundations
description:
Teaches absolute beginners the first open chord shapes (G, C, D, Em, Am),
correct finger placement with fret-hand diagrams, basic strumming patterns
(all-downstroke, down-down-up, alternating bass), and a first-song chord
progression sequence. Use when the user wants to start learning guitar,
asks about beginner chords, first strumming patterns, or how to hold and
fret a guitar. Do NOT use for intermediate barre chords or lead guitar
techniques, music theory beyond basic chord names (use music-theory-fundamentals),
or professional recording setup (use home-recording-starter).
